QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Parched Lands
QuestInfo.1:
#p9400464# is convinced that her ancestors once dwelt on Eluna, and is searching for evidence of why they might have left.
Find evidence of the ancient Ryuul on Eluna Prime, take a photo with the provided camera, and show it to #p9400464#.
#r#eHint:#n Keep an eye out for a well-hidden path in the Earthen Rise.#k#p9400464#.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered the ruins of what looks like a facility once used to extract and purify. Now that you think about it, you haven't seen a single drop of water on Eluna Prime. Perhaps that's why #p9400464#'s ancestors left Eluna?

default.0: Have you found any more evidence of my ancestors?\r\nYou may need to travel deeper into the planet's unexplored landscape. If you find anything, take a picture and bring your camera back here.
